title: Practice 12: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Сопрано получила оглушительные аплодисменты за ___ (своё выступление).
exercises.prompt: The soprano received thunderous applause for her performance.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.
